title: Partial extended b-metric and some fixed point theorem
summary: In this paper, we introduce the concept of partial extended b-metric spaces (PEBMS) as a unification and generalization of extended b-metric spaces and partial b-metric spaces. This new structure incorporates a point-dependent control function together with the possibility of non-zero self-distance, providing a more flexible framework for the study of generalized metric spaces. We establish several fundamental properties of PEBMS, including convergence, Cauchy sequences, and 0-completeness.
